in_sanskrit.name: गोविंद
in_sanskrit.meaning: गोविंद् के नाम से 'गोद हुआ या प्रांत है' अर्थात 'गोद प्रांत है' में सिंधूर है।
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Govind' comes from the Sanskrit words 'go' meaning cow, 'vind' meaning present or 'found'. The name thus translates to 'God, or Lord, is present'.

in_marathi.name: Govid
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Govid हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Govid is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for the deity Krishna, who is also known as the god of cows. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'go' meaning cow and 'vid' meaning knowledge. Govid represents the divine protector and sustainer of all cows and cattle, and is often invoked for their protection and prosperity.
